title: serpocaulon polystichum
intro: Serpocaulon polystichum, commonly known as Polystichum, is a type of fern plant that belongs to the Dryopteridaceae family. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, offering several health benefits such as anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial activities. The therapeutic actions of Serpocaulon polystichum include its ability to reduce fever, soothe skin irritations, and relieve respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents present in this plant include flavonoids, phenolic compounds, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
